Drawer (bottom sheet)

Source: R/tier3-overlays.R
shad_drawer.Rd

A bottom drawer with drag-to-dismiss. input$<inputId> is the open state.

Usage

shad_drawer(
  inputId,
  ...,
  title = NULL,
  description = NULL,
  footer = NULL,
  trigger = NULL,
  class = NULL
)

Arguments

inputId

Input id.

...

Body content.

title, description

Optional header text.

footer

Optional footer content.

trigger

Optional tag whose click opens the sheet.

class

Extra CSS classes.

Value

A drawer tag.

See also

shad_drawer_open(), shad_drawer_close()

Other shadshiny tier-3 components: shad_accordion(), shad_alert_dialog(), shad_carousel(), shad_collapsible(), shad_command(), shad_context_menu(), shad_dialog(), shad_dropdown_menu(), shad_hover_card(), shad_menu_parts, shad_menubar(), shad_message_scroller(), shad_navigation_menu(), shad_pagination(), shad_popover(), shad_resizable(), shad_scroll_area(), shad_sheet(), shad_sidebar_layout(), shad_tabs(), shad_tooltip()

Examples

shad_drawer("d", trigger = shad_button("Open"), title = "Goal", "Body")
#> <div data-shad="drawer" id="d">
#>   <button class="shad-btn shad-btn--default shad-drawer__trigger" type="button">Open</button>
#>   <div class="shad-drawer__overlay shad-anim-overlay" hidden></div>
#>   <div class="shad-drawer__content shad-anim-sheet" hidden>
#>     <div class="shad-drawer__handle" aria-hidden="true"></div>
#>     <div class="shad-drawer__header">
#>       <div class="shad-drawer__title">Goal</div>
#>     </div>
#>     <div class="shad-drawer__body">Body</div>
#>   </div>
#> </div>
